title: The God Slaying War Chariot
summary: Wounded after the fragment's collapse, Wang Lin meets Chi Hu, young leader of the Giant Demon Clan, and gives his name as Zeng Niu of Tianhun Country. Chi Hu shows him a jade slip map to a hidden central fragment with a jade coffin and asks him to team up within a month. Recovering, Wang Lin learns his golden iron is a jade slip left by the Celestial Tian Bao, pointing to the God Slaying War Chariot sealed in a tenth chamber of Tian Bao's cave. He helps Sima Yun of the Kuishui Sect against a thief, trades teleport maps with him, and finds the hidden chamber on Tiger Mountain, where he tames the smallest beast soul of the chariot. Then he goes to Chi Hu's meeting at the Cold Stream and finds that the third partner is Hongdie.
events: Chi Hu of the Giant Demon Clan meets the wounded Wang Lin, who calls himself Zeng Niu
Chi Hu invites him to raid a central fragment holding a jade coffin
Wang Lin learns celestial energy can only be used when he breaks through to Soul Transformation
The golden iron turns out to be Tian Bao's slip about the God Slaying War Chariot
Wang Lin helps Sima Yun and trades teleport maps with him
In Tian Bao's cave on Tiger Mountain he finds the chariot and tames its smallest beast soul
At the Cold Stream entrance Chi Hu's third partner turns out to be Hongdie
cultivation: Sima Yun is early Soul Formation. Wang Lin notes the celestial energy he gathered can only be refined when he breaks from late Soul Formation into Soul Transformation.
